t0013-01.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
t0013-01.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

t0013-02.gloss: A water mark crosses a field sketch without showing its source.
t0013-02.rival_reading: A response worker could record field conditions while checking a route; the ring and sketch do not establish that a program spread anything.

t0013-03.gloss: A dispatch copy closes a route but records no receiver.
t0013-03.rival_reading: A work crew could close its course and leave a receipt incomplete; the blank line does not show whether the order came from emergency response or a test.

t0013-04.gloss: A field count and a private reminder share one page.
t0013-04.rival_reading: A responder could record conditions beside a closed route and leave a family reminder; the crop count does not prove a program malfunction.
